title: Fly above Kauaʻi’s Nā Pali Coast
description: From a small aircraft or helicopter, the Nā Pali Coast appears as a succession of steep green folds dropping toward the Pacific. Watch ridges, waterfalls, and narrow valleys come into view one after another, places that no road crosses. The flight offers a sense of the coastline’s shape that is difficult to gather from any single beach or lookout.
teaser: See Kauaʻi’s roadless coast from the air.
goodToKnow: Weather, turbulence, aircraft boarding and weight policies require consideration.
whyItMightDelightYou: From above, you can understand at once why this coastline feels both immense and difficult to reach.
